item.description:
# Weft 1.0.13
- Simpler setup screens with clearer next actions and saved progress when preparation is unfinished. - Company account selection is remembered for each project, and existing AWS sign-in is checked when returning to setup. - Consistent project status and recovery guidance. Open Project becomes available after startup health checks pass. - Choose service failure, recovery, and memory notifications separately for each project. - Copy a support report with recent activity and output, with credential redaction improved. - Native Liquid Glass action buttons, a Settings button inside the sidebar, and larger pill-shaped service control groups. Selected service icons turn white for better contrast.
